# BASELINE FOR THE beta.26 MIGRATION - the ORACLE, captured BEFORE any change.
#
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The u1 -> bool rewrite touches pp/src/smt.nr, the SMT verifier every identity
# and title commitment depends on. A wrong rewrite does NOT fail loudly - it silently changes results
# and forks every commitment in the system. "It compiles" and even "the tests pass" are both weaker
# than they look: a test that was SKIPPED or RENAMED during the migration passes by not running.
#
# So the acceptance criterion is this exact roster, name for name, plus identical published vectors.
# Compare with:  nargo test 2>&1 | grep Testing | ...  (see the capture command in TODO.md sec. 2.4a)
#
# STATUS: pp is COMPLETE (87 tests). noir_dl_lib is INCOMPLETE - the capture timed out at 10 min
# before reaching it, so its 49-test roster must still be captured on beta.13 BEFORE migrating.
#
